environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing target group. MongoDB 5.0 on DocumentDB cluster in same VPC. ALB security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request filtering or WAF attached. Application accessible directly via ALB DNS name.

config.network: ALB public-facing, SG ingress 0.0.0.0/0:443, no WAF
config.origin_access: direct ALB DNS publicly resolvable and accessible
